Dear Willa Cole,

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-897135

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the debt as already paid. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation notice within five days of receiving your dispute letter. This notice will include the amount of the debt, the name of the original creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of the debt within 30 days, we will assume the debt is valid.

We have reviewed the account information and confirm that the current balance is $6,176.50. The original creditor for this account was Horizon Card Co. We have also confirmed that the charge-off date was January 9, 2022, and the last payment date was January 29, 2022.

We will provide you with a written validation notice as required by law. Please note that you have the right to dispute the debt further if you believe it is not valid. If you wish to dispute the debt, please provide us with a written statement within 30 days of receiving this letter.

Sincerely,

National Credit Solutions
